high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from the BBC website, displaying an article about a tragic incident that occurred at Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru, India. The text in the article mentions that when the tragedy struck, the gates of the stadium were not even opened, but there were so many people trying to push through a small gate that the stampede took place. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed his condolences, stating that the mishap was heartrending and that his thoughts were with those who lost their loved ones.
